releaseTitle: MusicDeck v3.0.11 - Bit-Perfect USB-DAC Passthrough & DeckAcoustix DSP Polish
releaseNotes: Milestone 2 Complete: Introducing Bit-Perfect USB-DAC Passthrough for external headphone amplifiers, DAC dongles, and studio USB audio interfaces. Features Android 14+ MIXER_BEHAVIOR_BIT_PERFECT to bypass the Android 48kHz resampler, dynamic track clock rate matching (44.1k to 192k at 16/24/32-bit), dual Pure Direct vs DeckAcoustix DSP modes, real-time signal path telemetry, Abbey Road 160Hz Low-Cut reverb filter, dynamic Playlist Play All theme color, and synchronized alphabet fast scroller.
